items.question: How far in advance should I book?
items.answer: We recommend reaching out at least 2–4 weeks before your event. For peak season or large setups, earlier is better — we'll always do our best to accommodate last-minute requests.

items.question: Do you deliver and set up equipment?
items.answer: Yes. We deliver and set up across Switzerland, Germany, and France. Delivery details and costs are confirmed in your quote.

items.question: Can I rent a single item?
items.answer: Absolutely. You can request individual items or a full package — tell us what you need in the inquiry form.

items.question: What if something goes wrong on-site?
items.answer: We offer optional on-site technical support. If an issue arises, contact us immediately and we'll help resolve it as quickly as possible.

items.question: How do I get a price?
items.answer: All pricing is tailored to your event. Submit a quote request and we'll reply with a detailed offer — no online checkout required.
